responsibility: This source file implements AArch64-specific assembly emission for ELF metadata notes that the backend adds to object files, specifically the `.note.gnu.property` record describing enabled hardening features. It owns the `section_note_gnu_property` logic that accumulates BTI, PAC, and GCS feature bits from backend code-generation decisions and writes the correctly aligned GNU property note to the assembler output, including optional annotated comments under `-dA`, so later linkers and loaders can see the object’s AArch64 feature requirements.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file for the shared AArch64 ELF-metadata interface: it contains the executable logic for `section_note_gnu_property`, including feature-bit accumulation and actual `.note.gnu.property` assembly emission. Unlike the paired header, it does not define the reusable AEABI metadata templates or public declarations; it realizes the GNU-property writer declared there.
